subject: english
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Smell blood

options.text: To sense a weakness in your opponent

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"Smell blood"** means to **sense a weakness in your opponent and to be ready to exploit it**. (कमजोरी महसूस करना) • **Example:** The competitors began to **smell blood** when they noticed the leader of the race was limping. • **"To sense a weakness in your opponent"** means to detect a vulnerability or a flaw in an adversary that can be taken advantage of. (अपने प्रतिद्वंद्वी की कमजोरी का पता लगाना) • **Example:** The boxer sensed a weakness in his opponent's defense and quickly took advantage. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Restart a work** (काम फिर से शुरू करना): To begin a task or project again. • **Example:** After the holidays, we need to restart the work on our new project. • **To sense malpractice** (धोखाधड़ी का आभास होना): To detect or suspect unethical behavior or wrongdoing. • **Example:** The auditor could sense malpractice in the company's financial statements. • **To be suspicious about something** (किसी चीज़ के बारे में संदेह होना): To have doubts or mistrust about a particular matter. • **Example:** She was suspicious about the sudden change in his behavior. 30:Tb9e, The correct answer is: **Option 3.**
